title: Chapter 133: Zerg Extreme Explosion
content:
Chapter 133: Zerg Extreme Explosion

With the damaged ghouls blocked in front by the Zerg biological decomposition fluid, the fierce attack of the ghouls was weakened.

The ghouls in the back could only push the ghouls in front to rush forward, and the Zerg puppies rushed up at the first time and fought with the remnants of the ghouls in front.

In terms of quantity, there are quite a few Zerg puppies now!

It’s just that relatively speaking, the ghouls now have more space to display their skills, while the Zerg are squeezed in the connecting channel and some of them can’t display their skills.

There are terrifyingly dense spikes underground, which alternately pierce at a very high frequency, causing huge damage to the crowded ghouls charging together.

The Zerg puppies fought head-on, the hydralisks and anti-aircraft towers attacked from the air, and the defensive spikes attacked from the ground.

With the close cooperation of all Zerg units, at the cost of the sacrifice of a large number of fearless Zerg puppies, the first wave of fierce attacks by the ghouls was successfully blocked!

As the ghouls continued to disappear, the number of ghouls near the connecting channel area began to decline rapidly.

But the number of ghouls was too large, and the ghoul sea tactics were perfectly displayed!

Before the ghouls in front were completely eliminated, more ghouls rushed up from the back, one wave after another, without rest!

Wu Qing once wanted to sweep everything with the sea of insects, but he didn't expect that not long after the start, he was taught a lesson by various seas in this world!

Faced with the continuous and powerful offensive of the ghouls, the Zerg could only invest more puppies to intercept. Long-range attacks alone could no longer stop such a fierce attack!

On the long fronts on both sides of the connecting channel, countless ghouls and Zerg puppies disappeared every second.

The air defense towers continuously sprayed biodegradable liquid at the ghouls, and the eight thousand hydralisks took turns in three attack modes in order to achieve the best attack effect.

The defensive ground spikes attacked non-stop, killing the ghouls at the bottom in large numbers.

This is a competition of hard power! Whoever is weak will lose! There is no trick!

If we only calculate based on the existing strength of both sides, the addition of ghouls has already put the Zerg at a disadvantage, because the number of enemies is too large, seemingly endless!

This is the illusion that the enemy has invested too much manpower, but the enemy has more manpower, this is the fact!

The Zerg's manpower is consumed very quickly, but fortunately the speed of increasing system resources is also accelerating! It is enough to support the Zerg to quickly enhance its strength.

Wu Qing directly upgraded all the 110 mother nests in the Zerg territory that had not been upgraded, except for the ten mother nests in the underground base of Daxia Territory, to one star.

In this way, as long as there are enough resources, the Zerg territory can hatch 1,100 Hydralisks or 2,200 Puppies every two minutes!

Based on the existing Zerg forces, plus this speed of rapid spawning, it is enough for the Zerg to hold out for a while under such a powerful attack by the ghouls.

A large number of Hydralisks are already somewhat unable to be used in the connecting channel, and more puppies are needed now.

More than 100,000 Zerg puppies are desperately fighting with countless ghouls on the battlefield of the connecting channel, and groups of puppies are gathering in the underground bases and cave spaces of the Zerg territory.

The Zerg has a system cheat here, but Wu Qing feels that the enemy's cheat is more powerful than his!

The Zerg still needs time to spawn troops, while the enemy directly has an endless army and can squander it to their heart's content!

He couldn't figure out how such a large number of ghouls and underground ratmen ran here from that magical underground world.

If the enemy can maintain such an offensive, the only thing Wu Qing can do is to do his best to maintain the status quo and persist until dawn!

If they really can't hold on, they can only abandon the cave base, retreat to the underground base in the Zerg territory, concentrate their forces, and use the favorable defense situation of the underground base to hold on until dawn!

Wu Qing had this idea because the Queen had just calculated the speed of the Zerg's army and the number of troops lost, and found that the current speed of the Zerg's army could not keep up with the speed of the army consumption!

The battle line is too long, and it is a two-line battle, which leads to the Zerg's dog's war loss rate is very fast. Even if there are more than 100,000 original numbers, it is estimated that it will be difficult to hold on until dawn.

In this case, instead of pinning hopes on the enemy's insufficient forces, it is better to increase the speed of the Zerg's army as much as possible!

Wu Qing began to build mother nests at the ground base and underground base in the Zerg territory at the same time. Now is not the time to consider whether resources are wasted. He wants to keep the cave base as much as possible.

After the Zerg mother nests were built, they were immediately upgraded to one star. Wu Qing increased the number of one-star mother nests in the ground base to 100 and the number of one-star mother nests in the underground base to 70.

There are exactly 200 one-star nests in the entire Zerg territory!

Building so many one-star nests requires a lot of resources, which is a waste considering the current development scale of the Zerg.

But under the current situation, we have to do this, which can be regarded as being forced.

In general, it is not a loss, and all the resources used are provided by the enemy.

When the number of one-star nests reaches this number, the Zerg territory can produce more than 100,000 Zerglings in one hour. At this rate of increase, it can barely maintain the consumption of troops on the front line.

The brutal offensive and defensive battle has been continuing at the highest intensity, and it has been more than an hour without knowing it.

Determined to defeat the unknown enemy, it did not expect that a small Zerg territory could actually produce so many troops. Wu Qing said it was cheating. If it understood the meaning of cheating, it would definitely scold Wu Qing for being a big cheater!

The actual area of the Zerg territory is indeed very small. There is not much space above and below the ground.

If it were not for the Zerg's terrifying ability to send troops, even if the territory was covered with puppies, it would not be able to defeat the current double attack of the ghouls and underground ratmen.

Just as Wu Qing did not believe that the enemy could send troops infinitely, the enemy did not believe that the Zerg territory could really hide so many troops. Because of the protection of the rules, the Zerg territory could not see the situation where the Zerg territory mother nest continued to produce larvae and hatched Zerg in an instant.

Wu Qing knew that ghouls were also hatched through eggs. According to his observation, those eggs needed time to settle and nutrients to hatch ghouls.

This is also the reason why the enemy did not expect the Zerg to have so many troops. The Zerg's rapid hatching ability is a cheating behavior that violates the rules of the world.

Wu Qing was not going to expose the Zerg's ability, which was why he did not build Zerg buildings outside the Zerg territory.

Zerg territory was considered a Zerg retreat, and outsiders were not allowed to approach.

The underground base of Daxia Territory's new city, the existing ten mother nests were heavily protected. In principle, people other than Zerg units were not allowed to enter.

Except for emergency needs, the ten mother nests were generally not used at will.
